text:
Aurora L: Hi all  Hello from Aurora, just started today in Platform Eng! Quick questions: who sets up GitHub org access, how do I get my parking badge, and is there a recommended devcontainer for local work? Also curious where people hang out for coffee chats.

Priya R: welcome Aurora! :wave: I can add you to the GitHub teams. DM me your GitHub username. Parking badge is handled by People Ops (people-ops@redwood.ai)  they'll mail you a temporary pass.

Sam W: for devcontainer we have a shared config in https://git.redwood.ai/infra/dev/devcontainer.json. Copy it into your repo and run `Remote-Containers: Open Folder` in VS Code. If you want GPU support locally use the `docker-compose.gpu.yml` variant.

DevEx Bot: Hi Aurora  Your onboarding checklist: 1) GitHub access 2) Okta MFA setup 3) laptop image request 4) assign mentor. Track it here: https://onboard.redwood.ai/2080012345. Reply "okta done" or "github done" to auto-update.

Aurora L: Thanks Priya/Sam! GitHub username is auroral. One more: what's the policy for signing e2e test keys? I saw a note in the handbook but couldn't find the key owner.

Nina M: @Aurora the e2e test keys are owned by QA infra (team: qa-infra). Ping @Sam W or me and we can open the key request. It usually needs a short justification and an expiry date.

Sam W: Adding to that: use this request template when filing the ticket:
```
Title: e2e key request - <repo> - <reason>
Body:
- GitHub handle: auroral
- Repo: infra/ci-e2e
- Expiry: YYYY-MM-DD
- Reason: automated tests for feature X
```

Priya R: Coffee chat spots: in-office there's a small table by the kitchen, but remote folks join our #morning-coffee thread at 9am PT. We do a 15-min intro round every Friday.

Aurora L: Great, I'll pop into Friday. Also, any swag I should grab? Hoodie sizes? :sweat_smile:

Nina M: I dropped a sticker pack and a water bottle on your desk (if you're on-site). If remote, order via Swag portal and choose "new-hire bundle". Hoodies ship on request.

Aurora L: All set, Priya added me to the GitHub org, Sam helped with the devcontainer and I filed the e2e key request. Okta MFA is next. Thanks for the warm welcome everyone! Looking forward to lunch/coffee chats. :rocket:
